headline: NO CORNER STACKS — Floor Boss learns corner clearance
lede: Racking the swing of a tight elbow is now refused at the click point: a rack whose service cell is the corner stalls carts on two aisles at once, exactly the choke real warehouses legislate away. Bays, plugged mouths and short arms keep their escapes; the autopilot's win proof transfers untouched.
